name: berrio_anglogold
text: 37 Capital Inc. announced an update on its Berrio Project in Colombia. The Berrio Project carries an existing 2% net smelter return (NSR) royalty held by AngloGold Ashanti. As 37 Capital advances the project toward drilling, the company confirmed the AngloGold Ashanti royalty remains in place over the property.

name: barsele_agnico
text: Gold Line Resources reported on the Barsele Gold Project in Sweden. As part of the consideration structure, Agnico Eagle Sweden AB retained a perpetual 2% NSR royalty on the Barsele Gold Project. The 2% NSR held by Agnico Eagle Sweden AB applies across the project area.

name: golden_rose_conquest
text: Inventus Mining and Conquest Resources provided an update on the Golden Rose claims. Conquest Resources is receiving a 2.0% NSR royalty on Golden Rose mining claims not already subject to an existing royalty. The 2.0% NSR in favour of Conquest Resources covers the newly staked claims.

name: farellon_thirdparty_vendor
text: Red Metal Resources reported that it holds a 10% net smelter return (NSR) royalty on ore sold from the Farellon 1/8 concessions in Chile, reduced to a net 8.5% after a pre-existing 1.5% vendor royalty held by a third party. The third-party 1.5% vendor royalty on the Farellon copper project predates Red Metal's interest.

name: guerrero_new_nsr
text: A news release describes a new 3% NSR royalty created on the La Guadalupana / El Senor de los Guerreros property in Mexico. The 3% NSR royalty was granted to the vendors of the property and includes a 2% buyback option exercisable for US$3M.

name: lucky_shot_buyout
text: Contango ORE announced it has bought out a 2% NSR royalty on its Lucky Shot gold project from Alaska Hardrock Inc. for total consideration of approximately US$16M. The 2% NSR previously held by Alaska Hardrock Inc. covered production from the Lucky Shot project.

name: negative_drill_results
text: Northern Star Exploration announced high-grade drill results from its flagship project, including 12.5 metres grading 8.2 g/t gold from 145 metres downhole. The results extend the mineralized zone 200 metres along strike. Assays remain pending for six additional holes. No royalty arrangements were disclosed.

name: negative_financing
text: Junior Explorer Corp announced a bought-deal private placement to raise gross proceeds of C$8 million through the issuance of units at C$0.45 per unit. Proceeds will fund exploration at the company's projects and for general working capital. Each unit consists of one common share and one-half of a warrant.
